title: Reabsorption
summary: REABSORP'TION, noun The act or process of inbibing what has been previously thrown off, effused or extravasated; the swallowing a second time.

inlines.v: REABSORP'TION, noun The act or process of inbibing what has been previously thrown off, effused or extravasated; the swallowing a second time.
